subject: Acceptance Trellis: pass/fail signals, evidence owners, and exit gates
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@clarifyhealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Acceptance Trellis: pass/fail signals, evidence owners, and exit gates

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the productive kickoff yesterday. Per our conversation, I sketched an \"acceptance trellis\" (attached) to make the evaluation pass/fail criteria explicit and to assign evidence owners for each check. High level: we want a short, testable set of gates that map to business signals Clarify cares about (throughput, latency, accuracy/precision on entity extraction, and false positive rate).

Key asks from your side: 1) confirm which downstream SLA matters most (latency vs throughput), 2) nominate a Clarify evidence owner for model-conforming samples, and 3) sign off on the sized validation dataset (we proposed ~2k annotated rows).

I've attached a working MAP (MAP_v1.xlsx) and a starter test catalog (eval-test-catalog.csv). The trellis groups checks into three buckets:
- Safety & privacy: no PHI leakage patterns, privacy redaction coverage (owner: Clarify security)
- Functional correctness: NER F1 >= 0.88 on holdout slice; intent accuracy >= 0.92 (owner: Clarify analytics)
- Operational tolerances: 95th pct latency < 450ms at 75% concurrency; per-token cost target <= $0.0008 (owner: Redwood infra)

If that looks good, can we lock the mutual action plan by Wednesday so we can schedule a smoke-run and a gated canary the week after?

Thanks — Jonas

--
Jonas Weber

From: Elena Rossi <elena@clarifyhealth.com>

Cc: Clarify Health POC <poc@clarifyhealth.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acceptance Trellis: pass/fail signals, evidence owners, and exit gates

Jonas —

Appreciate the clear draft. Quick answers:
1) Downstream priority is accuracy on entity extraction (we need high precision on medication and procedure labels) — latency is secondary but still important.
2) I'll put Priya Patel (cc'd on the POC alias) as Clarify evidence owner for labeled samples — she'll coordinate the dataset.
3) 2k annotated rows is acceptable as long as we can get stratified slices (meds/procs/high-risk).

A couple of questions on the trellis:
- For the NER F1 target, can you include per-slice pass thresholds (e.g., meds >=0.90, procedures >=0.87)?
- For redaction checks, we need an auditable evidence bundle that ties examples to the redaction rule that handled them. Is that already covered in the evidence-index?

We can aim to sign off Wednesday but need to confirm Clarify's legal team will accept the data handling notes in appendix B. I'll push there today.

Thanks — Elena

Jonas / Priyom —

I reviewed Elena's notes and updated the trellis sheet to include per-slice thresholds and an evidence checklist column. Two operational points from infra:
1) We'll own the canary telemetry dashboard (Redwood). For the MAP, we need Clarify to provide a small steady-state synthetic load we can use for latency characterization (10k synthetic requests over 1 hour).
2) For cost objectives we can propose two quantization knobs and a fallback policy (mixed-precision: 8-bit for non-sensitive slices). We'll include measured tokens/sec deltas in the MAP.

I've attached a short runbook stub inside the updated MAP_v1.xlsx and a compact CSV with the smoke-test cases (eval-test-catalog.csv). Priyom — please add engineers for the canary (names + slack handles) so we can schedule the rollout window.

Kimberly

Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Acceptance Trellis — locked for sign-off (MAP_v1)

Elena —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Per Kimberly's updates I've attached the revised MAP (MAP_v1.xlsx) and an evidence index (evidence-index.pdf) with explicit owners for each check and a sample deliverable for redaction audit. Highlights:
- Per-slice thresholds added: meds F1 >= 0.90; procedures F1 >= 0.87; overall NER F1 >= 0.88 (holdout).
- Evidence required at sign-off: 200 stratified annotated examples per slice; runbook with canary telemetry; export of redaction pairs for a 7-day window.
- Exit gates sequence: smoke-run success -> canary (1% traffic) with telemetry green -> full pilot (20% traffic) -> production sign-off.

Next steps: please confirm by end of day Thursday that Clarify legal accepts appendix B and that Priya will own the annotated dataset. Once we have that, I'll convert the MAP into a mutual action plan in HubSpot and propose a gating calendar (smoke-run next Tue, canary the week after).

Attachments: MAP_v1.xlsx (updated), eval-test-catalog.csv (smoke + canary cases), evidence-index.pdf (audit checklist).

Best — Jonas
